title: Lazur vs Willow Voice on Mac: fast AI dictation or a screen-aware assistant
metaTitle: Lazur vs Willow Voice: which one fits your Mac
description: Lazur vs Willow Voice for Mac: fast AI dictation with an offline mode, or a voice assistant that sees your screen and dictates. Prices from each site.
intro: Willow Voice is AI dictation with smart formatting and an offline mode. Lazur is a voice assistant for the Mac that also dictates: hold ⌥ ⌘ and it sees your screen and answers out loud.
tldr: Willow Voice is a dictation tool. Lazur is a voice assistant that also dictates.
Pick Willow Voice if typing by voice is all you need, on more devices.
Pick Lazur if you also want help with what is on your screen: answers, pointing at buttons, step-by-step guidance.
Lazur is free for 3 days, then $18/month.

verdict: Pick Willow if dictation is the whole job and you want it on Windows or iPhone too. Pick Lazur if you want screen-aware help on your Mac as well.

blocks.text: Want numbers for your own typing? Try the [speaking vs typing test](/tools/speaking-vs-typing-test).

faq.question: Is Lazur a good Willow Voice alternative?
faq.answer: If you want more than dictation, yes. Lazur dictates in any Mac app and also answers questions about your screen, points at buttons and guides you. If you only dictate, Willow Voice is a fine choice.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur and Willow Voice together?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as their shortcuts do not clash. Lazur uses hold fn to dictate and hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask.
